QuestInfo.name: Jane's First Challenge
QuestInfo.0: I hear #p103#'s found herself a new life ambition...
QuestInfo.1: Last time, I got #p103# some mushroom caps to help convince her dad to let her travel. Apparently, it didn't work. Now, she has a new dream: she wants to be an alchemist! A bit fickle, but whatever. She told me she needed certain materials to pursue her dreams... and I already knew exactly what she was going to ask for. She wants me to collect #b1 #t2022000##k, #b25 #t4000036##k, and #b25 #t4000039##k by defeating monsters, so she can make some #t2000004#s.
QuestInfo.2: I got the materials #p103# needed to make some #t2000004#s. If she fails... is the whole place going to blow up?

0.0: Hey! You helped me the other day! You know, even after I showed my dad the items you got me, he still wouldn't let me travel... Hmph. He said he knew I didn't get them myself.
0.1: I gave up on that dream shortly after. Ah well. Anyway, I want to ask you for another favor... Do you have time?
0.2: I have a new dream. Being a traveler would be too tough for a pretty girl like me anyway, hehe! So my new life ambition is to become a great alchemist! Oh, by the way! Do you know what an alchemist does? Even if you do, I'll give you a simple explanation again, to make sure you really understand.
0.3: An alchemist is someone who can freely manipulate different things that exist in this world and, with special techniques, transform them into something entirely new. In other words, it's a profession that can craft items imbued with mysterious powers from different materials.
0.4: But here's the thing... to make different items, I'll need materials. If you're not too busy, could you gather the ones I ask you for? In return, I'll give you whatever I make out of them. I can't promise exactly how it'll turn out... but what do you think?

yes.0: Awesome! Let's see... I'm going to need #b1 #t2022000##k, #b25 #t4000036##k, and #b25 #t4000039##k. Also, please take care of #r50 #o40#s#k and #r50 #o43#s#k. If all goes well, I can make #t2000004#s!

no.0: Well, now. If you don't have time to listen to a poor girl's plea... Fine, just let me know if you change your mind.

1.0: Yippee! You got #b1 #t2022000##k, #b25 #t4000036##k, and #b25 #t4000039##k! Now, my turn. I just gotta mix these babies together, and...
1.1: Voila! You know, this is my first time actually doing alchemy. Am I good or what? Here you go. Please take it as a gift.

yes.0: Wow. I've got a talent for this. I made #r10 #t2000004#s#k in my very first experiment. You did your part to help, of course! Thank you.

item.0: You haven't collected #b1 #t2022000##k, #b25 #t4000036#s#k, and #b25 #t4000039##k yet! I believe some vendors sell #t2022000#. You can get the other stuff from monsters.

mob.0: Hmm... It looks like you haven't defeated all the monsters I asked you to.
